question: Which team won the ICC Men's 120 World Cup 2024?
solution:

• England's victory is a testament to their strong bench strength, experienced players, and meticulous preparation, which played a pivotal role in securing the championship.
 
• The team excelled in all departments—batting, bowling, and fielding—making them the deserving winners of the tournament.
 
• The leadership of England's captain was instrumental in guiding the team to victory, with key performances from star players contributing significantly to their success.
